name: Kickboard Swimming
instructions: Hold a kickboard out in front of you with both hands and extend your arms while floating face down in the water. Keep your body flat and horizontal.
Kick continuously from the hips with relatively straight legs and a loose ankle, moving through the water using leg power alone. Keep your face in the water and lift your head only to breathe.
Kickboard sets isolate the legs and are commonly used for cardio conditioning and technique work. A 150 lb person will burn around 250 calories kicking with a board for 30 minutes.
